body.zh-Hant: 1847年10月2日生於波森（今波茲南），為普魯士軍官之子；少年入卡德特學校，1866年參加克尼格雷茨戰役，普法戰爭中參加色當戰役。1870至1911年服役軍中，最後以馬格德堡軍區司令將軍之階退役。
body.en: Born on 2 October 1847 in Posen (today Poznań), son of a Prussian officer; he attended cadet schools, took part in the battle of Königgrätz in 1866 and the battle of Sedan in the Franco-Prussian War. He served in the army from 1870 to 1911 and retired as a commanding general at Magdeburg.

body.zh-Hant: 1873至1876年入戰爭學院並以優異成績結業；1893年任第91步兵團團長（上校），1900年任第28師師長，1903年起任馬格德堡第四軍軍長，1911年以64歲退役。
body.en: He attended the War Academy in 1873–76 and graduated with an excellent certificate; in 1893 he became commander (as a colonel) of Infantry Regiment 91 and in 1900 commander of the 28th Division; from 1903 he was commanding general of the IV Army Corps at Magdeburg, and in 1911, aged 64, he retired.

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月21日他重新出任第八集團軍司令，魯登道夫為參謀長；8月26至30日的坦能堡戰役殲滅俄軍第二集團軍，9月6至15日的馬祖里湖區戰役擊敗俄軍第一集團軍。11月1日他取得東線全部德軍的指揮權。1916年8月29日接掌最高陸軍指揮部（OHL）；1919年退休。
body.en: On 21 August 1914 he was reactivated as commander of the Eighth Army with Ludendorff as chief of staff; the battle of Tannenberg (26–30 August) destroyed the Russian Second Army and the battle of the Masurian Lakes (6–15 September) defeated the Russian First Army. On 1 November he received command of all German troops on the Eastern Front. On 29 August 1916 he took over the Supreme Army Command (OHL); he retired in 1919.

body.en: On 26 April 1925 he was elected Reich President as a non-party candidate pressed on him by the right; on 10 April 1932 he was re-elected, beating Hitler. heading.en: Origins and naval service in World War I

body.zh-Hant: 1891年9月16日生於柏林近郊的格呂瑙；1910年入海軍。一戰中「布雷斯勞」號在土耳其指揮下於黑海作戰；1916年升為上尉後調入潛艇部隊，1918年10月以德國潛艇艇長身分被英軍俘虜。
body.en: Born on 16 September 1891 at Grünau near Berlin; he joined the navy in 1910. In the First World War the cruiser Breslau fought in the Black Sea under Turkish command; promoted in 1916, he was assigned to the U-boat arm, and in October 1918, as commander of a German U-boat, he was taken prisoner by the British.

Eintritt in die Marine, wo er zwei Jahre als Seekadett dient.
steht die "Breslau" unter türkischem Befehl und kämpft im Schwarzen Meer.

heading.zh-Hant: 潛艇部隊與大西洋海戰
heading.en: The U-boat arm and the Battle of the Atlantic

body.zh-Hant: 1935年他以希特勒的擁護者身分負責重建潛艇部隊，1936年任「潛艇領導人」，專注夜間水面攻擊與潛艇群的「狼群戰術」。1939年升少將並任潛艇部隊司令（BdU），統籌組織與作戰；1939至1945年的北大西洋反護航船團潛艇戰（大西洋海戰），使約2800艘船被擊沉。1942年升上將。
body.en: In 1935 he took charge of rebuilding the U-boat arm, and in 1936, as "Führer der U-Boote", he focused training on night surface attacks and group attacks (the "wolfpack" tactic). In 1939 he became rear admiral and Commander of U-boats (BdU), running both organisation and operations; the U-boat war on Allied convoys in the North Atlantic (Battle of the Atlantic), 1939–1945, sank about 2,800 ships. He was promoted admiral in 1942.

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍總司令、末任元首與戰後
heading.en: Navy commander-in-chief, last head of state and afterwards

body.zh-Hant: 1943年他兼任海軍總司令並晉升海軍元帥，接替被希特勒免職的雷德爾。1945年5月1日他依希特勒遺囑成為帝國總統，並取得政府權力與國防軍統帥權，5月8日宣布國防軍無條件投降，5月23日在弗倫斯堡被英軍免職並逮捕。1946年10月紐倫堡審判判十年徒刑；1980年12月24日卒於奧穆勒。此元首任期不另建候選。
body.en: In 1943 he additionally became commander-in-chief of the navy with the rank of Grand Admiral, replacing Raeder, whom Hitler dismissed. On 1 May 1945, named Hitler's successor as Reich President in his testament, he took over governmental power and supreme command of the Wehrmacht; on 8 May he announced the Wehrmacht's unconditional surrender, and on 23 May he was removed from office and arrested by the British at Flensburg. In October 1946 he was sentenced to ten years at Nuremberg; he died at Aumühle on 24 December 1980. This head-of-state term is not built as a candidate here.

In July 1944, recovered, he became Commander-in-Chief West; on 16 August he was recalled as a suspected accessory and replaced by Walter Model, and on 19 August he killed himself with a poison capsule.

In the First World War he first served as a platoon leader in Belgium and at Verdun, and in December 1917 he received the Pour le Mérite. On 22 June 1942, after the capture of Tobruk, Hitler made him field marshal; from June to August he advanced to El Alamein in Egypt. In October the British launched their offensive at El Alamein, and in November, after the British breakthrough, he began to retreat against Hitler's orders. In February 1943 he became commander-in-chief of Army Group Africa, and in March he left North Africa.

body.en: In July 1943, after the Allied landing in Sicily, he received command of Army Group B; in September he held the supreme command in northern Italy; in November he was charged with inspecting the defences on the French Atlantic coast. In July 1944, during the Allied advance in France, he was badly wounded in a low-level air attack near Caen. On 14 October two generals acting for the OKW accused him of involvement in the plot to kill Hitler, and in their presence he killed himself with a poison capsule.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年大戰開始時他重返現役，以第二十二軍司令身分參加波蘭戰役。1940年5月「克萊斯特裝甲集群」組成西線攻勢的矛頭；7月19日升上將。1941年4月參加巴爾幹戰役，6月起率第一裝甲集群攻入蘇聯，突破斯大林防線並攻佔羅斯托夫；與古德里安的裝甲集群在烏曼與基輔的包圍戰中俘虜約65萬人。
body.en: At the outbreak of war in 1939 he was reactivated and took part in the Polish campaign as commander of XXII Army Corps. In May 1940 "Panzergruppe Kleist" formed the spearhead of the western offensive; on 19 July he was promoted colonel-general. In April 1941 he took part in the Balkan campaign, and from June he led Panzergruppe 1 into the Soviet Union, breaking through the Stalin Line and taking Rostov; with Guderian's panzer group the Uman and Kiev encirclement battles took about 650,000 prisoners.

body.zh-Hant: 1942年1月1日他任新成立的第一裝甲集團軍總司令；9月9日接替李斯特任A集團軍群總司令，1943年2月1日升元帥。1944年3月30日他因與希特勒對東線戰事屢有歧見被解職，由莫德爾接替。戰後他被美軍逮捕後引渡南斯拉夫，1946年被判十五年，1948年轉交蘇聯並被判無期徒刑，1954年11月死於戰俘營。
body.en: On 1 January 1942 he became commander-in-chief of the newly formed 1st Panzer Army; on 9 September he succeeded List as commander-in-chief of Army Group A, and on 1 February 1943 he was promoted field marshal. On 30 March 1944, after repeated disagreements with Hitler over the conduct of the war in the East, he was retired and replaced by Walter Model. After the war the Americans arrested him and extradited him to Yugoslavia, where he was sentenced to 15 years in 1946; in 1948 he was handed over to the Soviet Union and sentenced to life, and he died as a prisoner in 1954.
